gloss: to entwine; to entangle; to involve

definitions.explanation: To wind or wrap one thing around another.
In cooking, to coat ingredients with sauce or seasonings.
To include or involve something as part of a discussion or plan.

examples.japanese: {蔦|つた}が{木|き}に{絡|から}めてある。
examples.english: Ivy is wrapped around the tree.

examples.japanese: {野菜|やさい}にソースを{絡|から}める。
{政治|せいじ}の{話|はなし}を{絡|から}めて{議論|ぎろん}した。
examples.english: We discussed it while involving politics in the conversation.

notes:
{絡|から}める is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}). The intransitive pair is {絡|から}む (to get tangled, to get involved).

ASPECT ({ている}):
{絡|から}めている indicates an ongoing action of entwining or involving.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [A]に[B]を{絡|から}める - to wrap B around A
- ソースを{絡|から}める - to coat with sauce
- {話|はなし}を{絡|から}める - to bring a topic into discussion
- {絡|から}め{取|と}る - to capture by entangling

COOKING USAGE:
In recipes, {絡|から}める commonly means to toss ingredients so they are evenly coated with sauce or seasoning.

{絡|から}める VS {絡|から}む:
- {絡|から}める (transitive): to wrap/involve something
- {絡|から}む (intransitive): to become entangled, to get involved
